sentences.text: Intan menyimpan bekal makanan di kulkas kecil di gerbong restoran.
sentences.en: Intan kept her packed food in the small fridge in the dining car.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 싸 온 음식을 식당칸 작은 냉장고에 넣어 뒀어요.

sentences.text: Bayu menulis jurnal setiap malam di balkon apartemennya.
sentences.en: Bayu writes in his journal every night on his apartment balcony.
sentences.ko: 바유는 매일 밤 아파트 발코니에서 일기를 써요.

sentences.text: Intan membaca jurnal ilmiah tentang tanaman obat selama perjalanan.
sentences.en: Intan read a scientific journal about medicinal plants during the trip.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 가는 동안 약초에 관한 학술지를 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Penghuni bisa menitipkan paket di loker dekat pintu masuk.
sentences.en: Residents can leave parcels in the lockers near the entrance.
sentences.ko: 입주민은 입구 근처 사물함에 택배를 맡길 수 있어요.

sentences.text: Sesampainya di stasiun, Intan menitipkan koper di loker penyimpanan.
sentences.en: On arriving at the station, Intan left her suitcase in a storage locker.
sentences.ko: 역에 도착하자 인탄은 여행 가방을 보관함에 맡겼어요.
